title: Fairy tales and fables
examples: Are fairy tales always true stories?
What is the difference between a fairy tale and a fable?
Where can I find more stories like this?

explain.say: Many stories start with the words once upon a time. They mean a long time ago.
A fairy tale is a made-up story. It often has kings, queens, giants or talking animals.
A fable is a short story with animal characters. It teaches a lesson.
Aesop told many fables a very long time ago, in Greece. People wrote them down later.
The lesson of a fable is called its moral. It tells you a good way to act.

draw.text: Moral: the lesson of the story

explain.say: In The Tortoise and the Hare, the slow tortoise keeps going and wins. The moral is to keep going.

faq.q: What is the moral of the story?
faq.a: The moral is the lesson the story wants you to learn. It tells you how to act in life.
asks: What should I learn from this?

faq.a: No, fairy tales are made up stories. They are meant for fun and imagination.
Aesop was a storyteller in Greece, about 2,600 years ago. He is famous for his animal fables.

faq.q: What is the difference between a fable and a fairy tale?
faq.a: Fables are short and use animals to teach a clear lesson. Fairy tales are often longer, with kings, queens, giants and spells.

faq.q: How do I find the moral?
faq.a: Think about what the characters did wrong or right. The good choice is usually the moral.
asks: How do I know the message?

facts: Fairy tales often have talking animals, giants or spells.
Fables usually have a clear moral lesson at the end.
Aesop is known for telling many animal fables.
The phrase 'once upon a time' starts many traditional stories.

quiz.say: The ant stores food for winter. The grasshopper only plays. Tap the moral.
quiz.why: The ant got ready for winter. So the moral is to work hard and plan ahead.

wrong.0: The grasshopper thought only about today, and then had no food for winter.
wrong.1: Rest is good, but the ant’s hard work is what helped in winter.

quiz.say: This short story has animals and a lesson. Tap the kind of story.
quiz.why: A fable is a short story with animals. It teaches a lesson.

wrong.1: A fairy tale often has kings, queens and giants, and it can be long.
wrong.2: A myth is an old story that explains how something began.

quiz.say: Tap the words that often start a fairy tale.
quiz.why: Once upon a time means a long time ago. Many fairy tales start this way.

wrong.0: This tells you the weather, but fairy tales usually start by saying it was long ago.
wrong.2: Yesterday was just one day ago, and fairy tales happen long ago.
